'''Flapjacks''' in the United Kingdom (not to be confused with the American pancakes also called flapjacks) are a type of bar made using rolled [[Cookbook:oats|oats]], [[Cookbook:butter|butter]], [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]], and [[Cookbook:Golden Syrup|golden syrup]]. They're great for packed lunches and the like. This is a simple version with no fruit or raisins added. Try serving with [[Cookbook:Whipped Cream|whipped cream]] or with melted [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate]] to dip.

== Ingredients ==
* 110 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] or 4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|light brown sugar]]
* 175 g (1½ cups or 6 oz) [[Cookbook:butter|butter]]
* 1 dessert spoon [[Cookbook:Golden Syrup|golden syrup]]
* 175 g (1½ cups or 6 oz) [[Cookbook:Rolled oats|rolled oats]]

== Procedure ==
#Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven temperatures|150°C (300°F or Gas Mark 2)]].
#Place the sugar, butter, and golden syrup together in a medium [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] and heat until the butter has melted.
#Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the oats.
#Press the mixture out over the base of a lightly-greased 7½-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (19 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) square [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|baking tin]].
#[[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]] in the centre of the oven for 40 minutes.
#When baked, allow to cool in the tin for 10–15 minutes before cutting into oblong bars.
#Leave until cold before removing the flapjacks from the tin, then store in an airtight container.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 150°C (300°F or Gas Mark 2).
Place the sugar, butter, and golden syrup together in a medium saucepan and heat until the butter has melted.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the oats.
Press the mixture out over the base of a lightly-greased 7½-inch (19 cm) square baking tin.
Bake in the centre of the oven for 40 minutes.
When baked, allow to cool in the tin for 10–15 minutes before cutting into oblong bars.
Leave until cold before removing the flapjacks from the tin, then store in an airtight container.
